summary: Frontend-only testing of Prompt 5 dashboard (/app). All 13 feature flows from the review request were exercised end-to-end against the public preview URL with Playwright. Login guard (redirects both /app and /app/orders to /login when logged out), demo login (any email/password lands on Control Tower), role switcher (Dispatcher -> /app/loads, Warehouse Lead -> /app/warehouse, Finance -> /app/finance, Owner -> /app, Ops Manager -> /app) all PASS. Control Tower: 5 KPIs render, 6 exception cards with status tags, option A/B/C selection works, 'Approve option B' flips tag to Handled by AI + toast 'Approved option B' + new agent-activity-feed entry at top, '41 handled by AI' handled-toggle expands, SVG live map with breakdown pin renders. Orders: ORD-1042 shows editable weight input, Approve creates in TMS (toast 'ORD-1042 created in TMS'), Escalate present. Loads: capacity-label flips 18/22 -> 22/22 with correct label text on add-part-load-btn; load switching works. Warehouse: pallet-7 and pallet-12 mark-fixed flip tags with toasts; retailer manual excerpt 'p. 42' present. Finance: INV-2211 shows Rs 3,600 variance; Approve -> 'Correction approved' toast; dispute button present; receivables aging rendered. Calls: all 4 calls present, native Devanagari (Hindi) + Gujarati scripts shown with English translations, 'pending native-speaker review' note present. Agents: changing dial, toggling allowed checkbox, editing lane benchmark EACH adds a NEW top row to audit-log (5 -> 6 -> 7 -> 8) with toast 'Guardrail updated'; audit-search filters correctly. Top bar: app-search-input returns canned app-search-answer with LR-8839 + Beawar on Enter; notifications bell opens radix dropdown; demo-data-badge visible. Theme toggle flips html.dark, persists to localStorage key 'haulage-theme' and survives reload. No horizontal overflow at 768px tablet or 390px mobile; 9 mobile nav items. Marketing site regression (/, /product/voice-ai) still renders. Zero console errors across all pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Calls.jsx was emitting double-prefixed testids: data-testid={`call-${c.id}`} where c.id is already 'call-1'/'call-2'/..., producing 'call-call-1'. The review request (and sensible selector hygiene) specifies 'call-1'/'call-2'. Fixed by changing to data-testid={c.id} so testids now resolve as 'call-1', 'call-2', 'call-3', 'call-4'. One-line test-infra fix, no functional change.
Warehouse rule text uses 'p. 42' (space) which is correct per the UI but worth noting that any test looking for 'p.42' (no space) will miss. Minor stylistic note only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard /app and all 8 subroutes verified. Important notes: (1) Nav testids are lowercased slugs: 'app-nav-orders', 'app-nav-loads-and-matching', 'app-nav-fleet', 'app-nav-warehouse', 'app-nav-finance', 'app-nav-returns', 'app-nav-calls', 'app-nav-agents', 'app-nav-control-tower'. (2) audit-log is a <table> with <tbody><tr>; use tbody tr for row counting. (3) Role switcher and notifications are radix DropdownMenus - click trigger then click menuitem by exact text. (4) Mock state resets on full page reload (frontend-only store, per spec) - don't chain state-changing tests across reloads. (5) Search answer requires Enter/submit, not just typing. (6) Theme preference key is 'haulage-theme' (shared with marketing site). (7) After my fix, Calls testids are now 'call-1'...'call-4' as specified.
